capabilities: Open a note in a chrome-less pop-out window via command palette or context menus
Assign persistent window colors stored in plugin data without modifying the note
Launch specific notes directly via an obsidian://just-note URI from macOS Shortcuts
Link to Just Note windows from other notes using the same URI as a Markdown link
disambiguation: Not a sticky-notes widget; it opens existing vault notes in minimal standalone windows.
extras: Licensed under GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. The Shortcuts launcher is macOS-specific; colors apply only to Just Note windows and never touch the Markdown file or its frontmatter.
intentEvidence: The project began as a reworking of Obsidian Sticky Notes
problem: Obsidian's workspace chrome (tabs, sidebars, ribbon) surrounds every note, making a single note hard to use as a standalone app-like window.

relations.evidence: The project began as a reworking of Obsidian Sticky Notes and retains acknowledgment

summary: Pop-out window launcher that opens an Obsidian note in a focused, minimal window without tabs, sidebars, or ribbon.
